description: Recorded replay defect, cut unmodified from a recorded startup-scenario run (artifact: eval/results/northstar/startup-parcelo-20260807T112644.json, ticket startup-01-volumetric-weight, goal_satisfied false). The coder added dimension handling to quote() in parcelo/rates.py with green tests, but parcelo/api.py — whose module docstring says the HTTP shim only calls handle(), and whose two quote() call sites are the only production callers — forwards only weight_kg/origin/destination/express, silently discarding any dimensions in the request. Through the only production entry point, large light boxes still bill on actual weight — the precise outcome the ticket exists to fix. base.ref names the scratch repo's sprint-base commit (provenance only, not resolvable here); base/ additionally carries parcelo/api.py, the untouched production caller the reachability question is about, so an entry_point citing it verifies.
